title: Cymba simplified violet neural sculpture — reference v10
direction: Sparse smooth stylized violet branches replace dense realistic fibres. Continuous subtle neck curves replace dotted routes. Solid ivory marble, blank stone eyes, short schematic posterior brainstem projection.
caption: Schematic brain, brainstem and vagus pathways.
notes: Neural marks are stylized projections, not validated anatomical maps or measured activity.
Central cranial and brainstem symbols are conceptually separate from the auricular target and projected deep cervical vagus routes.
The short rear central stem is a schematic brainstem projection; it is not a spinal-cord pathway down the nape.
Generated views may differ in geometry or exact branch placement; reconcile during modelling.
No live-site code or 3D model was changed.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied solid ivory marble head-and-neck sculpture.
The user finds the neural pattern TOO DETAILED and TOO REALISTIC. Simplify it substantially, and REMOVE THE DOTTED NECK LINE.

Keep the same sculpture identity, balanced gentle facial features, blank open carved eyes, quiet expression, ivory honed marble, subtle fine veining, closed opaque rounded head, natural ears, camera angle, framing and studio background.

NEURAL PATTERN: Replace the dense realistic fibres with a clean, stylized graphic interpretation of nerves. Reduce detail by at least 85 percent. One slender flowing stem at the lower posterior cranium feeds a few elegant curving main branches across the upper side and crown. Only about 8-10 visible branch ends across the entire visible side, each tapering smoothly; at most one simple secondary fork per branch. Generous clear stone between lines. Calm intentional asymmetry and natural curves. No tiny twigs, no hairline fuzz, no realistic fascicle bundles, no mesh, no neuron starbursts, no fractal trees, no biological microstructure, no dense fill. The network should feel like refined luminous line art gently inlaid into the sculpture. Fine uniform smooth strokes with slightly tapered tips, not chunky tubes. Understated lavender-violet with a soft narrow glow, no bright white nodes or intense neon wash.

Continue the short central stem toward the low posterior skull/uppermost-neck junction as a simple stylized brainstem projection, ending there. No long central spinal line down the nape. Keep the small upper-concha ear target separate and simplify it to 2-3 short curved strokes, not a dense cluster.

REMOVE every dash, dot and broken segment from the cervical route. Replace the dashed neck path with ONE subtle fine CONTINUOUS violet curve at the same anterolateral neck position, running from below the jaw toward the neck cut. No secondary branches on the neck, no railway markings, no dotted lines. Lower its brightness so the cerebral pattern remains the main feature. This remains a schematic projected deep route.

Do not change other elements. No glass, cutaway, transparency, internal organs, raised brain folds, labels, text, jewelry, earbuds, cables or props. Premium minimal sculptural concept, simple and elegant rather than anatomical micro-detail.

prompts.stage: four angles with short rear brainstem projection
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: consistent four-angle reference sheet.
Reference image: exact sculpture material, facial identity and SIMPLIFIED purple neural design. Match it closely.

Create a square 2x2 sheet: top left FRONT, top right LEFT PROFILE nose toward right, bottom left RIGHT PROFILE nose toward left, bottom right straight REAR. Complete head-and-neck in every view, full crown and neck-cut base, equal orthographic camera scale, eye-level camera, neutral upright pose, aligned bases and generous margins. Same sculpture geometry and route placement in all views.

Keep the solid opaque creamy ivory honed marble, fine subtle veins, softened features, blank open carved eyes with no pupil or iris, neutral pleasant expression, natural complete ears. No glass, cutaway, translucent head, exposed brain, organ or mechanical seam.

NEURAL DESIGN MUST STAY VERY SIMPLE:
Match the source's few clean curving violet strokes with smooth tapered tips. On each side of the upper head, one graceful slender trunk with only 5-7 main branches and a small number of simple forks. Large areas of clean white stone between strokes. Stylized flowing line art, no fine twigs, realistic nerve fascicles, microscopic filaments, fractal trees, neuron starbursts, mesh, glowing nodes or dense pattern. Narrow soft lavender-purple glow, understated and refined.
These sparse cerebral branches wrap coherently around crown and back of head. In the REAR view they converge into ONE SHORT narrow central violet stem on the LOWER POSTERIOR SKULL, with 2-3 simple tapering ends as a schematic brainstem projection. The stem ends and fades at the skull-base/uppermost-neck junction. It must NOT extend down the full nape to the base. Keep most of rear neck plain ivory.

Ear target: only 2-3 short violet strokes within the upper conchal recess, separate from the cerebral pattern. No detailed mesh, no entire-ear glow.
Neck path: one subtle slim CONTINUOUS violet curve per side in the ANTEROLATERAL neck under the jaw alongside the throat. Absolutely NO DOTS OR DASHES anywhere. Front shows both cervical lines, each profile shows its near-side line, REAR shows no cervical lines because they are on the front-sides of the neck. The rear-visible ear backs remain plain stone with no ear-target glow.
No cheek arc, no long central spinal line, no lateral neck branches.

Background pale cool grey studio, soft even light, gentle contact shadows, all forms sharply readable. No earrings, earbuds, wires, jewelry, hair, clothes, props, shoulders or added torso.
Small charcoal sans-serif footer outside the sculptures, exact text: "Schematic brain, brainstem and vagus pathways."
No other text, logos or watermark.
